_doc: Task 53 (no hints): who notices an act (scripts/systems/notice.gd) and what they do. sight / hear: tiles (hear is scaled by the act's noise 0..1); night outdoors halves the sight range. busy_mult: someone doing something else notices less. stealth_cut: how much a fully skilled sneak cuts the chance to be seen. reactions.<table>.<role>.<reaction>: w = weight, lines = what they say ({n} the noticer, {a} the actor). trait_mods: per trait, a multiplier per reaction id. knows_mods: when the noticer knows the actor.

lines: "Did you just take my picture?" {n} asks.
{n} frowns. "Delete that."
{n} grins and strikes a pose.
{n} laughs and waves at the camera.
{n} comes straight back at {a}, fists up.
{n} shoves {a} right back, harder.
"What is wrong with you?" {n} shouts.
{n} rounds on {a}. "Don't you ever do that again."
"Hey! Back off!" says {n}.
{n} backs away fast and doesn't look back.
{n} hurries off, looking over {their} shoulder.
{n} gets out a phone. "I want to report someone."
{n} steps away and calls the police.
{n} just shakes {their} head and walks on.
"Leave them alone!" {n} calls out.
{n} steps closer. "Everything all right here?"
{n} is on the phone, watching you.
{n} calls someone, staring at you.
{n} comes running. "Hey! That's my car!"
"Get away from my car!" {n} shouts.
{n} stops dead. "What do you think you're doing with my car?"
{n} already has the phone out. "Someone's breaking into my car."
{n} backs off, dialling. "Police, please. My car."
{n} grabs {a} by the collar. "Not my car, you don't."
{n} runs at {a}, yelling.
"Oi! Is that your car?" {n} calls over.
{n} slows down. "Everything all right there?"
"That's not your car, is it?" {n} asks.
{n} walks on quickly, phone to the ear.
{n} stops at a distance and makes a call, watching.
{n} freezes, hands up.
{n} goes very still. "Okay. Okay."
{n} runs.
{n} bolts across the street without looking back.
{n} backs off, already dialling the police.
{n} gets clear and calls the police.
{n} lunges at {a} anyway.
{n} grabs for the weapon.
"Put that down!" {n} shouts.
{n} is on the phone to the police, staring at you.
{n} calls the police from across the street.
{n} crosses the street fast.
{n} turns and walks the other way, quickly.
"Hey! Put that away!" {n} shouts.
